abstract: OpenCV is the open-source computer vision toolkit/library that ships C++, Python and Java bindings for image processing, feature detection, camera calibration (camera intrinsic / camera extrinsic estimation, lens distortion / radial distortion correction, pinhole model), stereo, structure from motion (SfM), object tracking, marker detection (aruco, charuco, checkerboard, chessboard) and a large surface area of classical and learning-based vision primitives. Used as a baseline library across calibration, target detection, 3D geometry, and industrial visual inspection pipelines.
reason: Mature, ubiquitous baseline for calibration, fiducials, stereo, and tracking. Already a hard dependency of every pipeline we ship.
title: OpenCV
